title: ▶️ Ancapex Live: Gonka Overview
description: YouTube stream with Yakov, co-founder of Ancapex. A review of everything important in Gonka over the past months: inference, proposals v0.2.14–v0.2.15, model training, mining and token price, governance, and the roadmap.

title: AMA with Gleb Morgachev — Dev Team Funding proposal
description: AMA session with Gleb Morgachev (@gmorgachev, co-founder of Gonka) about the proposal to fund an independent development team (Dev Team Funding). We will discuss key issues: what tasks the funding is requested for; how the independent development team will be structured; the funding mechanics; cost transparency, reporting, and Gleb’s role in the initiative. Language: Russian. Hosts: @paranko and @dem_ww. Zoom: the link will be provided at the start of the session. Proposal: https://github.com/gonka-ai/gonka/discussions/1464
